description: With decades of experience, strong humanitarian values, and a deep commitment to serving people, Mr. Md. Lucky Mia continues to help shape the vision and journey of The Jannath Foundation UK as its Founder and Secretary.
heading: Building Hope, Creating Positive Change
paragraph1: For more than 30 years, Mr. Md. Lucky Mia has been actively involved with various organizations, social initiatives, and humanitarian activities, dedicating his time, experience, and efforts to serving people and supporting meaningful causes.
paragraph2: Through his long-standing involvement with different organizations, he has gained valuable experience in community service, social responsibility, and organizational activities. His extensive experience, passion for serving others, and commitment to standing beside people continue to play an important role in strengthening the vision and work of The Jannath Foundation UK.
